listing.eventDescription: One game with studio, publisher, genres, release date, price, and review count, but no studio website.

lead.eventDescription: A game with the studio website, plus studio, publisher, genres, release date, price, and review count.

qualified_lead.eventDescription: A game with a scraped contact email and reviews at or above the qualified bar. A reachable, established studio. The first qualified lead per run is free so you can validate output.
